name: globortunity
description: A policy-aware remote job collection and search platform.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @globortunity/domain && npm run build -w @globortunity/database && npm run build -w @globortunity/api && npm run build -w @globortunity/worker && npm run build -w @globortunity/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @globortunity/domain && npm run build -w @globortunity/database && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @globortunity/api" "npm run dev -w @globortunity/worker" "npm run dev -w @globortunity/web"
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @globortunity/domain && npm run build -w @globortunity/database
scripts.test: npm run test -w @globortunity/domain && npm run test -w @globortunity/database && npm run test -w @globortunity/api && npm run test -w @globortunity/worker && npm run test -w @globortunity/web
